analysis.reasonEn: Previous 3 trading days maintained a wait-and-see stance. Today, RSI at 39.3 consolidates in the neutral zone, and the MACD histogram shows improvement (-1.0949 → -1.0007), which is positive. However, trend strength (ADX 30.3) remains at a sustained level. The price is rising from the 5-day low ($281.03) to $286.54, entering the initial phase of a Higher Low pattern. Low volume (0.42x) reduces the reliability of a trend reversal. The overall market (QQQ +1.7%) shows positive momentum, but this stock is positioned at $286.54, 5.6% below its 52-week high ($305.18) and approaching resistance ($287.58). With volatility (ATR $3.57), a stop loss of 1.3x ATR and a target of 2.6x ATR can secure a risk-reward ratio of 1.5 or higher. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
